baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence جَاءَهُم بِالْحَقِّ ... قَالُوا اقْتُلُوا ... وَاسْتَحْيُوا anchors a spoken policy directly to the truth's arrival.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival, speech, killing, and deliberate non-killing form one reaction chain. The response does not merely reject a proposition; it converts rejection into an asymmetric allocation of death and continued life.

activation_trace.role: Coming and becoming present supplies the event that triggers the reaction chain.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the resistant reality that has arrived.
Uttered speech turns the reaction into an explicit executable command.
Taking life supplies the lethal side of the ordered sorting.
Keeping alive and refraining from killing supplies the deliberately preserved side of the same sorting.

changed_reading.before: They rejected the truth and persecuted its followers.
changed_reading.after: The truth's arrival immediately elicited a voiced sorting policy that assigned death to one group and continued life to another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command targets أَبْنَاءَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ while preserving نِسَاءَهُمْ, not an undifferentiated population.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sons carry the branch image of descent from a source, while women are retained as a distinct group. The death/life asymmetry therefore attacks the believers' lineal continuation and social composition, whether or not that was its only immediate purpose.

activation_trace.role: Sonship, descent, and attribution to an origin make the killed group the believers' lineal continuation.
Heart-settled assent marks the parent community whose continuation is being selected against.
Purposeful preservation from killing makes survival an imposed policy rather than incidental escape.
The collective of women supplies the explicitly retained demographic category.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a cruel but generic act of persecution.
changed_reading.after: The verse reports a calibrated assault on a believing community's descent and composition: its sons are removed while its women are deliberately retained.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَا كَيْدُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ places the agents' stratagem inside ضلال rather than merely labeling it wicked.
baseline_models.mechanism: Those who cover the truth apply an intense contrivance, but the contrivance is enclosed in deviation and loss. Its violence may be effective locally while the plan as a plan cannot find or retain its intended destination.

activation_trace.role: Scheming and contrivance supply the organized design behind the selective violence.
Covering supplies the agents' functional relation to the truth they seek to suppress.
Blocking or denying truth specifies what the covering accomplishes in this conflict.
Deviation from the intended path makes the strategy directionally defective.
Loss of the sought object makes failure internal to the stratagem rather than an external moral comment.

changed_reading.before: The disbelievers' plot is condemned as misguided.
changed_reading.after: Their organized suppression is itself pathless: even when it inflicts harm, it loses the end for which it was designed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, truth is paired with decisive judgment, and the coming of God's command culminates in judgment by truth. This revises the focus arrival from delivery of correct information toward the onset of a reality that exposes and decides, making the kill order a defensive reaction to impending adjudication.

activation_trace.role: The truth's coming supplies the focus event whose force is revised by later judgment sequences.
Fixed truth supplies the reality that the coercive response cannot alter.
The paired presence and absence of decisive judgment makes truth the criterion of operative ruling.
Truth explicitly accompanies God's judging, activating a judicial dimension in the focus truth.
The command's coming repeats the arrival pattern at the moment of final decision.
The arriving affair supplies the enacted event rather than a merely debated claim.
Decisive judgment supplies the consequence of that arrival.
Truth again qualifies the judgment, closing the arrival-to-verdict mechanism.

structural_cues: 40:20 opposes God's judging by truth to others' inability to judge anything.
40:78 orders coming command, judgment by truth, and the loss of falsifiers in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated arrival, truth, command, and judgment links; I infer that 40:25's arrival begins adjudicative exposure. A live alternative is that the focus phrase denotes revelation alone and the judicial force is only a later echo.

changed_reading.before: Correct teaching arrived, and the rulers answered it with violence.
changed_reading.after: An exposing and ultimately decisive truth arrived, and the rulers answered the onset of that verdict with violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier national pattern joins resolved intention, seizure of messengers, false disputation, and attempted displacement of truth. The focus kill order is therefore one local execution of a recurring suppression script in which bodily capture and argumentative destabilization serve the same end.

activation_trace.role: Contrived scheming names the focus policy as designed action rather than spontaneous rage.
An intention contracted in the self supplies the planning stage of the recurring script.
Seizure and capture supply coercive control of the messenger and its reversing consequence.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the false medium used in the dispute.
Making an argument fall supplies the intended displacement of truth.
Fixed truth is the common object that both coercion and false disputation try to remove.

structural_cues: 40:5 moves from communal resolve to seize a messenger, then from false disputation to attempted displacement of truth.
40:25 similarly moves from truth's arrival to a communal command of coercive violence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two ordered suppression sequences; I infer that capture, debate, and selective killing are substitutable instruments in one recurring mechanism. The alternative is a looser historical analogy without a unified operational script.

changed_reading.before: The focus records an isolated tyrannical reaction.
changed_reading.after: The focus instantiates a repeatable regime script: plan, seize or kill, and use coercion or false argument to displace an arriving truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The threatened sons are later counterposed by the children of Israel inheriting the Book and by the surah's full child-to-maturity arc. The order can thus be read as an attempt to interrupt biological and textual succession, while the surah portrays the attacked line as continuing into inheritance and maturity.

activation_trace.role: Descent from a source makes the killed sons bear the threatened line of continuation.
Taking life supplies the attempted break in that continuation.
Transmission of knowledge or Book as inheritance supplies a continuation that outlives the coercive order.
The children named by descent reappear as the receiving collective rather than an extinguished line.
The small child supplies the beginning of the developmental continuity targeted in the focus.
Reaching full strength supplies the maturation endpoint that killing sons attempts to prevent.

structural_cues: 40:53 places guidance, inheritance, children, and Book in one compact statement.
40:67 explicitly sequences origin, child, full strength, old age, and appointed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threatened sons, later children inheriting the Book, and an intact maturation sequence; I infer an attempted severing of communal transmission. Immediate terror, labor control, or political intimidation remain materially live alternative purposes.

changed_reading.before: The sons are victims within a moment of persecution.
changed_reading.after: The sons embody a succession the regime tries to cut, while the surah answers with an inheriting line and a protected arc from child to maturity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus disbelievers cover truth through public coercion, while a believer inside Pharaoh's people temporarily conceals faith, then voices an objection and is protected. Concealment is split by function: one covering suppresses truth and life; the other preserves a bearer until testimony can emerge.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the suppressive action named by the focus agents.
Believing assent marks the community whose truth and lives are being suppressed.
Hiding and covering supply a protective, temporary mode of concealment inside Pharaoh's own people.
Belief and the concealed faith keep the hidden content continuous with the focus believers.
Protection that repels harm completes the preservation function of the hidden believer's trajectory.

structural_cues: 40:28 identifies a believer within Pharaoh's people, states that he conceals faith, and then gives him public speech against killing.
40:45 later states that he is protected from the evils of their devising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercive covering, concealed faith, subsequent speech, and protection; I infer two ethically opposed technologies of concealment. The alternative is that the hidden faith is individual prudence without a deliberate counter-mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief and belief are opposing convictions in the focus conflict.
changed_reading.after: They also generate opposed uses of covering: power covers truth by violence, while hidden faith preserves a truthful witness inside power's own house.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus formula is echoed by Pharaoh's plot being only in ruin, followed by the evil of devising descending around Pharaoh's people; even the disbelievers' later call is only in error. The plot's ضلال is thus not inactivity but a process that misses its end and folds its harm back around its makers.

activation_trace.role: The focus scheme supplies the designed process whose trajectory is tested by the later echoes.
Deviation from destination supplies the focus judgment on that trajectory.
Pharaoh's named scheme directly repeats and localizes the focus stratagem.
Loss and destruction give the repeated formula an explicit failed endpoint.
Descending evil that surrounds its target supplies the plot's reflexive return around Pharaoh's people.
Calling and attempted verbal reach supply another operation that fails to arrive at its desired response.
The repeated in-error formula extends pathlessness from coercive plotting to futile calling.

structural_cues: 40:25 and 40:37 share the construction that a plot is only in a failed state.
40:45 reverses direction by placing the encircling evil of the devising upon Pharaoh's people.
40:50 repeats the only-in-error construction for the disbelievers' call.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel formulas, an explicit ruin term, and an encircling reversal; I infer directional and reflexive failure. A live alternative is that each formula independently states eventual judgment without describing one shared causal geometry.

changed_reading.before: The plot is misguided and will ultimately fail.
changed_reading.after: The plot moves, harms, and organizes, yet cannot reach its intended end; its trajectory bends into ruin and surrounding harm for its makers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus regime uses sex and relation to believers to allocate death and survival. The later male-or-female believer formula instead joins both sexes under one condition of faithful good action and one outcome. The two passages enact rival systems for classifying human worth and destiny.

activation_trace.role: Male descendants supply the category marked for death by the coercive classification.
The collective of women supplies the category marked for imposed survival.
The male category is placed inside a shared moral conditional rather than assigned a separate fate.
The female category is paired with the male under the same moral conditional.
Believing assent supplies the shared condition that displaces the regime's sex-based allocation.
Right action supplies the evaluative criterion applied equally across the paired sexes.

structural_cues: 40:25 assigns opposite immediate outcomes to sons and women.
40:40 coordinates male and female under the same faith-and-action condition and the same promised entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit gender pairings with opposed allocation rules; I infer a deliberate contrast between coercive demographic valuation and shared moral agency. The alternative is that 40:40 is generally inclusive without directly answering 40:25's policy.

changed_reading.before: The focus order is a gender-selective tactic of persecution.
changed_reading.after: The order also exposes a rival regime of valuation: tyranny sorts sexes into death and survival, while the surah later gives male and female the same moral agency and horizon.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from sonship to architecture through one root inventory. It remains anchored in focus أَبْنَاء and the later imperative to build, but downstream prose should present it as root-image resonance, not claim that أَبْنَاء literally means buildings.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ب ن ي names the sons selected for destruction; 40:36 uses the same root for Pharaoh's command to build a tower.

activation_trace.role: Sonship and descent supply the living construction of a continuing community.
Joining parts into a structure activates the exploratory building image within the word for sons.
The command to construct supplies Pharaoh's competing investment in an engineered material structure.
The high building specifies the monumental form of the structure Pharaoh chooses to raise.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh destroys sons in one episode and orders a tower in another.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, power destroys the believers' living architecture of descent while commanding that its own monumental architecture be raised.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus uses prepositional عِند while the inventory also carries an obduracy branch. It remains anchored through repeated ع ن د occurrences that contrast truth from near Us with knowledge held near them; render it only as an epistemic and root-sound resonance, not as a syntactic derivation of obstinacy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The truth comes مِنْ عِندِنَا in 40:25, while 40:83 depicts people rejoicing in the knowledge عِندَهُم before the mocked consequence surrounds them.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence locate the truth's source as what is with Us.
Obdurate resistance to known truth supplies a contained exploratory shadow, not the direct sense of the preposition.
Nearness in judgment places the unsupported disputation before both God and the believers.
What is held near them supplies a rival, possessed epistemic center.
Knowledge disclosed to its knower specifies the content in which they rejoice.
The surrounding descent of what was mocked exposes the limit of their at-hand knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Truth from God confronts people who reject it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the conflict is also between rival epistemic nearnesses: truth from what is with Us and confidence in what is merely held with them.

strongest_changes: Truth's arrival became the onset of exposure and judgment, not only delivery of correct information.
The selective killing became an attempted break in communal succession, answered by inherited Book and an intact child-to-maturity arc.
The plot's location in ضلال became operational pathlessness and reflexive failure, not only moral condemnation.
Concealment split into violent covering of truth and protective concealment of faith within Pharaoh's own people.
The male-female contrast exposed rival systems for assigning human worth and outcome.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetitions align arrival, truth, judgment, plotting, ruin, and reversal, while the ب ن ي network unexpectedly juxtaposes destroyed sons, inheriting children, and Pharaoh's commanded tower.
remaining_uncertainties: The lineal reading is strong as a function of the selective order, but immediate terror, labor control, and political intimidation remain possible co-purposes.
The tower and ع ن د activations are root-network resonances and should not be promoted into literal lexical claims.
The focus states that the women are kept alive; it does not itself specify their later status or use.
